title: **Playback Controls**
description:
`Play` Search for a song and start playing, or add it to the queue.
`Pause` Temporarily pause the currently playing song.
`Resume` Continue playback from where you left off.
`Skip` Skip the current song and play the next one.
`Stop` Stop playback, clear the queue, and disconnect from voice.
`NowPlaying` View the current song and its playback details.
`AutoPlay` Automatically discover and play related songs when the queue ends.

title: **Queue Management**
description:
`Queue` View all upcoming songs in your listening queue.
`Shuffle` Randomize the order of upcoming songs.
`Remove` Remove a specific song from the queue.
`Loop` Repeat the current song or the entire queue.

title: **Voice & Audio**
description:
`Join` Connect the bot to your current voice channel.
`Leave` Disconnect from voice and clear the current queue.
`Volume` Adjust the playback volume between 0% and 100%.

title: **Channel Configuration**
description:
`LogChannel` Set a dedicated channel for music activity logs and playback updates.
`DJChannel` Set a dedicated channel for the interactive music player and its controls.
